![](images/09915116c8383d6b33e782f95b8e19957d86a590449679aecbcb40fb1f85b580.jpg)  
Figure 1: Our proposed framework enhances text data augmentation for low-resource local communities through a multi-stage pipeline.First,it (a)generates educational data using machine translation. Next, it (b)creates diverse, culturall-aware texts,such as stories and conversations,by simulating scenarios with local personas through controlled synthetic data generation. Finaly,it (c) enriches the model with local knowledge by retrieving and parsing culturally specific web content.This entire process enables controlled text generation and retrievalaugmented pre-training, ensuring the cultural and value alignment of large language models for Arabic dialects.
